common.comingSoonBody: It arrives in the next phase of the plan.
common.noBuildingsBody: Create the first building — give it a login and password, then add floors, departments and rooms.

auth.signInSubtitle: Enter the building's login and password
auth.throttled: Too many attempts. Try again in a few minutes
auth.staySignedIn: You sign in once — the password is not asked again. Use sign out to end the session.
auth.buildingNote: Each building has its own login and password. Once signed in you see every floor and department of that building.

dashboard.title: Dashboard
dashboard.emptyBody: No sensors have been assigned to this building yet.

plan.hintDepartments: Pick a department to see its rooms.
plan.hintRooms: Pick a room to see its sensors.
plan.dragAdmin: You can drag the cards to arrange them.

settings.passwordNote: Only an administrator changes the password — the account belongs to the building, not to a person.

history.maxSeries: At most {count} sensors — more than that cannot be told apart by colour.
history.empty: No readings in this range. Pick another period, or check that the poller is running.

admin.noFloors: No floors yet. Add the first one above.
admin.needRooms: Create a room first — a device needs somewhere to live.
admin.nameFromRoom: A sensor takes its room name; a number is appended when the room already has one.
admin.title: Administration
admin.noDepartments: No departments on this floor yet. Add one above.
admin.noRooms: No rooms in this department yet. Add one above.
admin.hintFloors: Pick a floor to see its departments.
admin.hintDepartments: Pick a department to see its rooms.
admin.hintRooms: To attach a sensor, go to “Connect sensors”.
admin.thresholdsHelp: These limits apply to the whole building. A per-sensor value wins over them.
admin.overrideHelp: Only fill this in for sensors that genuinely differ — a fridge, for example.
admin.loginTaken: That login or name is already taken.
admin.buildingNote: The login and password ARE the building account. Password: 8 characters minimum.
admin.providerFailed: Could not load the device list. Check the Tuya keys.

tuya.step1: iot.tuya.com → Cloud → Development → Create Cloud Project (Smart Home).
tuya.step2: API subscriptions: IoT Core, Authorization, Smart Home Basic Service, Device Status Notification.
tuya.step3: Devices → Link Tuya App Account → scan the QR in Smart Life. Without it no devices are visible (error 1106).
tuya.step4: Find your region in the app (Me → Settings → Account and Security → Region) and put it in .env.local:
